es.title: 07:20 H I 22 OCT 2026 I HERRERA EN COPE EN LA RIOJA
es.description: Los agricultores y ganaderos riojanos organizan movilizaciones ante el incremento constante de los costes de los carburantes y los fertilizantes, así como por la baja rentabilidad de sus explotaciones. El sector prepara una protesta en Madrid y un acto simbólico en Logroño para exigir medidas que frenen las pérdidas económicas y faciliten el relevo generacional en el campo, donde resulta cada vez más complejo mantener los negocios familiares. Por otra parte, la localidad de Autol prepara las jornadas dedicadas al champiñón y la seta. La Rioja se sitúa como la principal productora de champiñón en España, al concentrar la mitad del volumen nacional y generar unos dos mil quinientos puestos de trabajo, aunque los cultivadores también sufren un continuo aumento en los costes fijos de mantenimiento. En el ámbito gastronómico, los cocineros Cristian Solana e Igor González logran la victoria en el Campeonato de España de Cocina Salada. Su propuesta culinaria triunfa mediante dos platos tradicionales basados en la tenca y el jabalí, elaborados con diversas técnicas que recuperan la esencia de los guisos tradicionales y demuestran la importancia de la disciplina profesional.

gr.title: «Παγίδα θανάτου» στον Κολωνό: Τι ερευνά η αστυνομία, τα δύο σενάρια
gr.description: Για την ώρα έχει αποκλειστεί προσωρινά το ενδεχόμενο της τρομοκρατικής ενέργειας και γι’ αυτό τον λόγο τις έρευνες έχουν αναλάβει οι αστυνομικοί του ελληνικού FBI. Υπολείμματα εκρηκτικού μηχανισμού και ναρκωτικών έχουν βρεθεί στον τόπο της έκρηξης στον Κολωνό, που προκάλεσε τον τραυματισμό δύο αστυνομικών και δύο πολιτών, σύμφωνα με τα μέχρι στιγμής στοιχεία της έρευνας που πραγματοποιεί το Τμήμα Εξουδετέρωσης Εκρηκτικών Μηχανισμών. Όπως μετέδωσε η ΕΡΤ και επιβεβαιώνεται από αστυνομικές πηγές, ο μηχανισμός, από τα ευρήματα φαίνεται ότι αποτελείτο από μια δισκέτα από ηλεκτρική κουζίνα ή ζυγαριά κουζίνας, μπαταρία και μπουτόν, καθώς και άγνωστη εκρηκτική ύλη. Σύμφωνα με αρμόδιες πηγές η συσκευή με τη δισκέτα που φαίνεται ότι εξερράγη μπορεί να χωρέσει περίπου 500 γραμμάρια εκρηκτικής ύλης. Ωστόσο, οι ειδικοί εκτιμούν ότι η ποσότητα της εκρηκτικής ύλης ήταν μικρότερη, γιατί η έκρηξη ήταν μικρής ισχύος, αλλά ικανή να προκαλέσει τους τραυματισμούς όσων ήταν κοντά. Οι αξιωματικοί της ΕΛ.ΑΣ, με βάση τα μέχρι στιγμής στοιχεία εκτιμούν ότι η υπόθεση είναι του κοινού εγκλήματος, για αυτό την έρευνα έχει αναλάβει η Διεύθυνση Αντιμετώπισης Οργανωμένου Εγκλήματος, αν κι ενημερώθηκε και η Αντιτρομοκρατική Υπηρεσία. {https://exchange.glomex.com/video/v-dmb3a83ab7x5?integrationId=40599y14juihe6ly} Το χρονικό της υπόθεσης Σύμφωνα με όσα έχουν γίνει γνωστά από την αστυνομία, μετά το μεσημέρι ο διαχειριστής του κτιρίου ειδοποίησε την Άμεση Δράση ότι είχε βρει μια σακούλα κάτω από την σκάλα της εισόδου, που όπως είδε περιείχε ναρκωτικά. Ο άνδρας ενημέρωσε ακόμη έναν από τους ιδιοκτήτες που μένουν στην πολυκατοικία και περίμεναν τους αστυνομικούς. Στο σημείο μετέβη περιπολικό του Τμήματος Ασφάλειας Κολωνού, με πλήρωμα έναν ανθυπαστυνόμο και μια γυναίκα αστυνομικό. Οι δύο πολίτες τους έδειξαν τη σακούλα, την οποία άνοιξε ο άνδρας αστυνομικός και άρχισε την έρευνα, καθώς πράγματι είδε πως περιείχε ναρκωτικά χάπια, «φιξάκια» με ναρκωτικά και ζυγαριά ακριβείας. Κατά την έρευνα όμως πάτησε πιθανότατα το μπουτόν, που όπως αποδείχτηκε ήταν εξάρτημα του εκρηκτικού μηχανισμού, με αποτέλεσμα να σημειωθεί ή έκρηξη, στις 15.34 ακριβώς, το απόγευμα. Ο ανθυπαστυνόμος - ο οποίος είναι σοβαρά, αν και δεν κινδυνεύει η ζωή του - σύμφωνα με τα μέχρι στιγμής στοιχεία, φέρει εγκαύματα στο πρόσωπο, στα μάτια, στα χέρια και στα πόδια και βρίσκεται στο χειρουργείο του 401 Στρατιωτικού Νοσοκομείου όπου διακομίστηκε, ενώ η γυναίκα και οι δύο πολίτες τραυματίστηκαν ελαφρά και μεταφέρθηκαν στον Ευαγγελισμό. Πού προσανατολίζονται οι Αρχές Οι αξιωματικοί της ΔΑΟΕ συλλέγουν στοιχεία και μαρτυρίες από την περιοχή, καθώς και υλικό από κάμερες, στο πλαίσιο της έρευνας για τον εντοπισμό του δράστη ή των δραστών, ενώ ερευνάται ποιος ήταν ο παραλήπτης της σακούλας με τα ναρκωτικά. Οι αστυνομικοί δεν αποκλείουν να ήταν στόχος ο παραλήπτης και να είχαν παγιδευτεί τα ναρκωτικά, για αυτό την έρευνα κάνει το Τμήμα Ανθρωποκτονιών. Σύμφωνα με πληροφορίες του Action24, στην πολυκατοικία διαμένει άτομο που είχε στο παρελθόν εμπλοκή με υποθέσεις ναρκωτικών, το οποίο πιθανότατα θα κληθεί να καταθέσει στις Αρχές. Η ΕΡΤ πάλι υποστηρίζει πως υπάρχουν δύο αντικρουόμενα σενάρια που εξετάζονται: Το πρώτο είναι να άφησε κάποιος τη σακούλα με τα εκρηκτικά για να παγιδεύσει κάποιο πρόσωπο, ενώ το δεύτερο είναι να υπήρξε κάποιο πρόσωπο το οποίο ήθελε να ξεφορτωθεί τη σακούλα με τα εκρηκτικά. {https://exchange.glomex.com/video/v-dmb3spq8gxqp?integrationId=40599y14juihe6ly} #ΚΟΛΩΝΟΣ #ΕΚΡΗΞΗ #ΤΡΑΥΜΑΤΙΕΣ

sg.title: Middle East Conflict Threatens Global Growth as Commodity Prices Surge, Coface Warns
sg.description: Economic risk insurer downgrades Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Qatar as rising energy costs fuel inflation concerns. The escalating conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine are driving up commodity prices, tightening financial conditions and threatening global economic growth, according to trade credit insurer Coface. The company estimates that the Middle East conflict could reduce global growth by 0.5 percentage point in 2026 and 2027. Oil prices exceeded $100 a barrel in September, while natural gas prices have nearly doubled. Coface forecasts global growth of 2.5% in 2026, down from 2.8% in 2025, before a slight recovery to 2.6% in 2027. In its latest assessment, Coface downgraded three countries and upgraded four. It also revised 20 sector risk assessments, including 12 downgrades and eight upgrades. Gulf Economies Face Mounting Risks Economic activity is expected to contract across Gulf Cooperation Council countries in 2026, Coface said. Saudi Arabia's risk assessment was downgraded from A3 to A4 because of its exposure to attacks on energy infrastructure and disruptions to export routes. The United Arab Emirates fell from A2 to A3, while Qatar was downgraded from A3 to A4. Both countries are vulnerable to disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. Rising energy prices and supply chain disruptions are also renewing inflation concerns. Wheat prices rose 40% year over year following strikes on Black Sea port terminals and summer heatwaves in Europe. The Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank have each raised interest rates by 25 basis points in response to renewed inflationary pressures, contributing to tighter global financial conditions. Agriculture and Regional Growth Under Pressure Coface downgraded the agri-food sector in six countries. In France, Austria and Poland, the changes reflect extreme summer weather. In Saudi Arabia and the UAE, heavy reliance on food imports increases vulnerability to international price shocks. Argentina's agricultural sector continues to face high costs, tight margins and business failures. Economic performance remains uneven worldwide. The U.S. economy is supported by household spending, AI investment and a 4% unemployment rate. Europe is performing slightly better than expected, driven by resilient growth in Germany and Spain, although concerns persist over French public finances. In Asia, Vietnam and India are forecast to grow by 8.4% and 7.5%, respectively, supported by infrastructure spending and AI-related technologies. China's weakening domestic demand and rising energy costs in Thailand and the Philippines are weighing on regional momentum. Africa and Latin America remain vulnerable to persistent inflation driven by higher agricultural and energy prices, with El Niño adding to the risks. Global Outlook Remains Uncertain Despite mounting pressures, the global economy has remained resilient, partly thanks to AI-related investment. However, Coface warned that prolonged conflict in the Middle East could trigger another global inflation shock. Higher energy, commodity and transportation costs are forcing central banks to maintain restrictive monetary policies, creating a more challenging environment for vulnerable economies and businesses. With growth expected to remain below 2025 levels in 2026, geopolitical developments and commodity price movements will be critical to the global economic outlook.

The 16-fibre-pair MViSTA cable is expected to enter service in late 2028 with an estimated cost of about US$400 million, said Mark Procter, deputy head of Stavian High Tech Infrastructure, a unit of Vietnamese conglomerate Stavian Group and one of the project's developers. The project's backers excluded Chinese suppliers from bidding and designed the route to avoid the vast area claimed by Beijing in the South China Sea, Procter said. Stavian is also planning a data-centre campus in southern Vietnam linked to the cable, with "no Chinese company involved in any key technology deployed" in the cluster, he added. Communist-run Vietnam maintains a delicate balance between major powers and has emerged as a key arena in the competition between US and Chinese technologies, with Washington pressing Hanoi to avoid Chinese vendors in submarine cables, telecoms and AI technology due to concerns about security that could impact investments. However, Vietnam last year awarded contracts to Chinese telecom firms Huawei and ZTE for parts of its 5G rollout, in a major shift which raised concerns among US and European officials. MViSTA is backed by the US. APTelecom, a consultancy working with the US government on cable infrastructure, facilitated the formation of the group of shareholders, worked on the feasibility study and is helping secure customers for the cable and the data-centre campus, Procter said. Alongside Stavian, the project's shareholders include Tokyo-based investment firm Midas Capital and LitUp Network, a subsidiary of Malaysia's OMS Group, which will be responsible for laying the 2,500-km (1,550-mile) cable, Procter said. HYPERSCALE CAMPUS The cable's estimated cost, supplier shortlist and extent of US involvement are reported here for the first time. The tender for the supply of the cable is underway with a decision on the winner slated for later in October, said Procter, who is also the chief operating officer of the special purpose vehicle set up to develop and operate the cable. ASN said it does not comment on ongoing tendering activity. NEC did not respond to a request for comment. US cable maker SubCom was also invited to bid but declined because of existing commitments, Procter said. The project is significant for Vietnam, which is prone to recurring cable outages and plans to expand the number of submarine cables connecting the country to at least 15 by 2030 from six now. Procter said the government sped up approval procedures for the project. Stavian plans to connect the MViSTA cable to a new campus in southern Vietnam. The campus is designed to host data centres for "hyperscale cloud and AI infrastructure operators", according to a September statement from the US Trade and Development Agency (USTDA), which is funding a feasibility study. The study, due for completion in March 2027, will assess the deployment of trusted technology and evaluate whether US restrictions on exports of advanced semiconductors could affect the planned 1-gigawatt infrastructure, Procter said. The cable-linked campus could address infrastructure constraints that have prevented big US tech firms from investing in data centres in Vietnam. But investments will also depend on Vietnam's regulatory framework, Procter said, with restrictions on cross-border data flows often cited by industry bodies as a key barrier. sg.title: A 'Blue Great Wall' Rises on the Gobi Desert
sg.description: HOTAN, China, Oct. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The 1-million-kilowatt photovoltaic desertification-control project in Minfeng, Hotan, Xinjiang, built with the participation of China Railway 23rd Bureau Group, has recently achieved full-capacity grid connection of all 101 arrays. It is one of southern Xinjiang's largest integrated centralized photovoltaic and desertification-control projects and a "green Great Wall" at the desert's edge that combines ecological benefits with energy value. A 'Blue Great Wall' Rises on the Gobi Desert The project has a total investment of 2.97 billion yuan and covers more than 14.6 million square meters. It uses an innovative three-dimensional ecological management model: power generation above the panels, sand stabilization beneath the panels and grass planting between the panels. While generating electricity, the photovoltaic panels provide shade for drought-tolerant sand-stabilizing plants beneath them, reducing water evaporation and promoting vegetation recovery. Once operational, the project's first-year on-grid electricity output is expected to reach 1.9 billion kilowatt-hours, equivalent to saving 580,000 metric tons of standard coal and reducing carbon dioxide emissions by 1.55 million metric tons. It will not only effectively supplement clean energy supply to the southern Xinjiang power grid and ease the local imbalance between power supply and demand, but also inject strong "green momentum" into Xinjiang's efforts to build a national comprehensive new energy base and promote high-quality development in southern Xinjiang.

sg.title: Rznomics Granted Orphan Medicinal Product Designation for RZ-001 for the Treatment of Glioma by the European Commission
sg.description: SEONGNAM, South Korea, Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Rznomics Inc., a biopharmaceutical company specializing in the development of RNA-based gene therapies, announced today that the European Commission (EC) has granted Orphan Medicinal Product Designation to 'taspitimagene advec(RZ-001)', its RNA-editing gene therapy for the treatment of glioma. The designation follows the positive opinion adopted in September 2026 by the Committee for Orphan Medicinal Products (COMP) of the European Medicines Agency's (EMA). This marks RZ-001's first regulatory designation in Europe and further strengthens its development foundation across the two major markets of the United States and Europe. Orphan Medicinal Product Designation is intended to encourage the development of medicines for rare, serious, or life-threatening conditions. The program offers regulatory and development benefits, including the possibility of market exclusivity following approval, reduced development fees, and support to enhance clinical development efficiency for orphan drugs. "Following its designation in the United States, RZ-001's orphan designation in Europe provides further positive momentum for its development," said Bomi Kim, Head of the Drug Development Center at Rznomics. "Building on this milestone, we will continue to communicate the value of RZ-001 to potential global partners." "Glioblastoma has a poor prognosis and remains an area of significant unmet medical need," added Dr. Seong-Wook Lee, CEO of Rznomics. "With the European Commission's orphan designation of RZ-001, we will continue our efforts to develop RZ-001 as a potential new treatment option for patients with difficult-to-treat cancers." RZ-001 has also secured several regulatory designations from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), supporting its development prospects and potential partnering value. The FDA has granted Orphan Drug Designation (ODD) and Fast Track designation for RZ-001 for treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and glioblastoma (GBM). In addition, RZ-001 received Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation for HCC in May 2026. Rznomics aims to advance global partnerships and expand the commercial potential of RZ-001. In addition to HCC and GBM, which are currently under clinical development, the company is pursuing expansion into additional solid tumor indications. About Glioblastoma (GBM) Glioblastoma is the most common and aggressive primary malignant brain tumor in adults, classified as a WHO Grade IV tumor. Characterized by rapid progression, high recurrence rates, and resistance to standard therapies, recurrent glioblastoma remains an area of significant unmet medical need with limited effective therapeutic options available globally. About Orphan Medicinal Product Designation in the European Union Orphan Medicinal Product Designation in the European Union is intended to encourage the development of medicines for rare, serious, or life-threatening conditions. Designated products may benefit from regulatory incentives, including protocol assistance and fee reductions. Following marketing authorization, eligible products may receive ten years of market exclusivity, which may be extended to twelve years in certain circumstances. The EU orphan designation assessment considers several factors, including the rarity and severity of the disease, the rationale for developing the medicinal product, and the availability of existing treatments. Where approved treatment methods already exist, evidence supporting the potential for the investigational product to provide a "significant benefit" to patients is an important consideration. How RZ-001 (taspitimagene advec) Works RZ-001 utilizes Rznomics' proprietary RNA trans-splicing ribozyme technology. The ribozyme embedded in RZ-001 selectively recognizes and cleaves hTERT mRNA expressed in cancer cells, replacing it with an RNA strand containing a suicide gene (HSV-TK) derived from the herpes simplex virus. Subsequently, the orally administered antiviral prodrug valganciclovir, is converted to ganciclovir and further activated by HSV-TK, generating cytotoxic metabolites that inhibit viral and cellular DNA synthesis and selectively induce apoptosis in cancer cells. About Rznomics Inc. Rznomics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in South Korea focused on developing RNA-based gene therapies. The company's proprietary trans-splicing ribozyme platform enables precise RNA editing and has broad applicability across multiple indications. The company signed a research collaboration and license agreement with the global pharmaceutical company Eli Lilly in May 2025 for the development of a novel RNA editing therapeutic and listed on the KOSDAQ market in December 2025. ph.title: Peso sinks to new intraday low, nears halfway to ₱64:$1 on dampened investor confidence
ph.description: Dampened investor sentiment over the Philippines’ external position inflicted serious damage on the Philippine peso, pushing it closer to ₱64 per United States (US) dollar during Thursday’s trading session and raising the risk of breaching the threshold should oil prices stay elevated and the dollar continues to rally. Following the historic low close of ₱63.361 against the US dollar last Wednesday, Oct. 21, the peso continued to weaken on Thursday, Oct. 22, reaching ₱63.47:$1 and marking the lowest intraday level for the local currency. According to the Bankers Association of the Philippines (BAP), the peso opened at ₱63.31:$1 before shedding 16 centavos to hit the record intraday low as of 1:31 p.m. John Paolo Rivera, senior research fellow at state-run policy think tank Philippine Institute for Development Studies (PIDS), said the continued decline of the peso could be blamed on persistent demand for the safe-haven dollar, elevated price pressures stemming from ongoing geopolitical uncertainties, and the worsening balance of payments (BOP) position. Rivera said these factors “continue to weigh on investor sentiment and the country’s external position.” According to the economist, the expected interest rate hike by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) could help anchor the peso by supporting peso-denominated assets and narrowing the interest rate differential between the US and the Philippines. Prior to the BSP’s fifth policy meeting on Oct. 22, the key interest rate stood at five percent, having last been raised in August. Last September, the US Federal Reserve (Fed) opted to raise its benchmark interest rate by a quarter-point to a range of 3.75 to four percent. However, Rivera noted that support from monetary tightening could be minimal if external pressures persist. “Monetary tightening can help moderate depreciation but it cannot fully offset global dollar strength and structural external imbalances,” he said. Ser Percival K. Peña-Reyes, a senior research fellow at Ateneo Center for Economic Research and Development (ACERD), said the local currency continued to fall amid a robust US dollar, driven by uncertainty over the US interest rate outlook and high oil prices. Peña-Reyes also cited other drivers, including domestic vulnerabilities such as “external deficits and persistent demand for dollars.” “External pressures are the main trigger, amplified by our reliance on imports,” he said. He added that the peso could fall further toward ₱64 against the greenback in the near term, especially if oil prices remain elevated. “Reaching ₱64 per dollar is a realistic near-term risk,” Peña-Reyes said, noting that the current intraday low would require only roughly a one-percent depreciation to reach ₱64:$1. “If oil stays expensive and the dollar strengthens, ₱64:$1 could be tested within days or weeks,” Peña-Reyes said. However, the decline could slow if military tensions in the Middle East ease or the US dollar weakens.

ph.description: SEONGNAM, South Korea, Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Rznomics Inc., a biopharmaceutical company specializing in the development of RNA-based gene therapies, announced today that the European Commission (EC) has granted Orphan Medicinal Product Designation to 'taspitimagene advec(RZ-001)', its RNA-editing gene therapy for the treatment of glioma. The designation follows the positive opinion adopted in September 2026 by the Committee for Orphan Medicinal Products (COMP) of the European Medicines Agency's (EMA). This marks RZ-001's first regulatory designation in Europe and further strengthens its development foundation across the two major markets of the United States and Europe. Orphan Medicinal Product Designation is intended to encourage the development of medicines for rare, serious, or life-threatening conditions. The program offers regulatory and development benefits, including the possibility of market exclusivity following approval, reduced development fees, and support to enhance clinical development efficiency for orphan drugs. "Following its designation in the United States, RZ-001's orphan designation in Europe provides further positive momentum for its development," said Bomi Kim, Head of the Drug Development Center at Rznomics. "Building on this milestone, we will continue to communicate the value of RZ-001 to potential global partners." "Glioblastoma has a poor prognosis and remains an area of significant unmet medical need," added Dr. Seong-Wook Lee, CEO of Rznomics. "With the European Commission's orphan designation of RZ-001, we will continue our efforts to develop RZ-001 as a potential new treatment option for patients with difficult-to-treat cancers." RZ-001 has also secured several regulatory designations from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), supporting its development prospects and potential partnering value. The FDA has granted Orphan Drug Designation (ODD) and Fast Track designation for RZ-001 for treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and glioblastoma (GBM). In addition, RZ-001 received Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation for HCC in May 2026. Rznomics aims to advance global partnerships and expand the commercial potential of RZ-001. In addition to HCC and GBM, which are currently under clinical development, the company is pursuing expansion into additional solid tumor indications. About Glioblastoma (GBM) Glioblastoma is the most common and aggressive primary malignant brain tumor in adults, classified as a WHO Grade IV tumor. Characterized by rapid progression, high recurrence rates, and resistance to standard therapies, recurrent glioblastoma remains an area of significant unmet medical need with limited effective therapeutic options available globally. About Orphan Medicinal Product Designation in the European Union Orphan Medicinal Product Designation in the European Union is intended to encourage the development of medicines for rare, serious, or life-threatening conditions. Designated products may benefit from regulatory incentives, including protocol assistance and fee reductions. Following marketing authorization, eligible products may receive ten years of market exclusivity, which may be extended to twelve years in certain circumstances. The EU orphan designation assessment considers several factors, including the rarity and severity of the disease, the rationale for developing the medicinal product, and the availability of existing treatments. Where approved treatment methods already exist, evidence supporting the potential for the investigational product to provide a "significant benefit" to patients is an important consideration. How RZ-001 (taspitimagene advec) Works RZ-001 utilizes Rznomics' proprietary RNA trans-splicing ribozyme technology. The ribozyme embedded in RZ-001 selectively recognizes and cleaves hTERT mRNA expressed in cancer cells, replacing it with an RNA strand containing a suicide gene (HSV-TK) derived from the herpes simplex virus. Subsequently, the orally administered antiviral prodrug valganciclovir, is converted to ganciclovir and further activated by HSV-TK, generating cytotoxic metabolites that inhibit viral and cellular DNA synthesis and selectively induce apoptosis in cancer cells. About Rznomics Inc. Rznomics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in South Korea focused on developing RNA-based gene therapies. The company's proprietary trans-splicing ribozyme platform enables precise RNA editing and has broad applicability across multiple indications. The company signed a research collaboration and license agreement with the global pharmaceutical company Eli Lilly in May 2025 for the development of a novel RNA editing therapeutic and listed on the KOSDAQ market in December 2025. A 'Blue Great Wall' Rises on the Gobi Desert
ae.description: HOTAN, China, Oct. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The 1-million-kilowatt photovoltaic desertification-control project in Minfeng, Hotan, Xinjiang, built with the participation of China Railway 23rd Bureau Group, has recently achieved full-capacity grid connection of all 101 arrays. It is one of southern Xinjiang's largest integrated centralized photovoltaic and desertification-control projects and a "green Great Wall" at the desert's edge that combines ecological benefits with energy value. A 'Blue Great Wall' Rises on the Gobi Desert The project has a total investment of 2.97 billion yuan and covers more than 14.6 million square meters. It uses an innovative three-dimensional ecological management model: power generation above the panels, sand stabilization beneath the panels and grass planting between the panels. While generating electricity, the photovoltaic panels provide shade for drought-tolerant sand-stabilizing plants beneath them, reducing water evaporation and promoting vegetation recovery. Once operational, the project's first-year on-grid electricity output is expected to reach 1.9 billion kilowatt-hours, equivalent to saving 580,000 metric tons of standard coal and reducing carbon dioxide emissions by 1.55 million metric tons. It will not only effectively supplement clean energy supply to the southern Xinjiang power grid and ease the local imbalance between power supply and demand, but also inject strong "green momentum" into Xinjiang's efforts to build a national comprehensive new energy base and promote high-quality development in southern Xinjiang.

iq.title: الذهب يتراجع إلى 4115 دولاراً للأونصة مع ترقب قرار الفيدرالي الأميركي
iq.description: شفق نيوز- متابعة تراجعت أسعار الذهب في مستهل تعاملات الأسواق الآسيوية، يوم الخميس، مع ترقب المستثمرين اجتماع مجلس الاحتياطي الاتحادي (البنك المركزي الأميركي) الأسبوع المقبل، بحثاً عن مؤشرات بشأن مسار أسعار الفائدة. وانخفض الذهب في المعاملات الفورية بنسبة 0.6% إلى 4115.50 دولاراً للأونصة، فيما تراجعت العقود الأميركية الآجلة للذهب تسليم كانون الأول بنسبة 0.4% إلى 4132.30 دولاراً. وتتجه الأنظار إلى اجتماع الفيدرالي يومي 27 و28 تشرين الأول الجاري، إلى جانب بيانات نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي الأمريكية المرتقبة الأسبوع المقبل، التي تعد مؤشراً رئيسياً للتضخم. وبحسب أداة "فيد ووتش" التابعة لمجموعة "سي إم إي"، لا تتجاوز احتمالات رفع الفائدة الأميركية الأسبوع المقبل 16%، فيما تصل توقعات رفعها في كانون الأول إلى 90%. وتأتي هذه التحركات وسط تصاعد التوترات في الشرق الأوسط، بعد مقتل شخصين إثر اعتراض الدفاعات الجوية السعودية طائرة مسيّرة كانت تستهدف منشأة في حقل شيبة النفطي. وفي المعادن النفيسة الأخرى، تراجعت الفضة بنسبة 1.1% إلى 57.33 دولاراً للأونصة، وانخفض البلاتين بالنسبة نفسها إلى 1609.95 دولاراً، فيما هبط البلاديوم بنسبة 0.8% إلى 1078.52 دولاراً.

mg.title: AÉROPORT D’IVATO - La qualité de service irrite les usagers
mg.description: Demandes d’argent, fouilles contestées, contrôles mal compris : des passagers mettent en cause les pratiques de certains agents à l’aéroport international d’Ivato. Leurs témoignages soulèvent la question du traitement des plaintes et de l’identification des responsabilités. Plusieurs passagers expriment leur insatisfaction à l’égard des contrôles effectués à l’aéroport international d’Ivato. Ils font état de demandes insistantes d’argent ou de cadeaux de la part de certains agents, de procédures qui seraient volontairement ralenties et d’inspections qu’ils jugent arbitraires. Selon eux, ces pratiques viseraient à les inciter à payer pour accélérer leur passage. Des usagers dénoncent également les conditions de fouille et de manipulation de leurs bagages. « Lors de mon dernier voyage, des objets ont disparu de mes bagages et ma valise a été endommagée », a témoigné hier Stéphane, un passager. Les vérifications des documents de voyage suscitent aussi des interrogations. « Ma fille, qui partait étudier à l’étranger, a été bloquée à l’aéroport, soi-disant parce que son visa posait problème. Pourquoi la validité de son visa a-t-elle soudainement posé problème avant d’être acceptée dès le versement de quelques dollars ? », s’interroge un père de famille. Il dénonce une pression exercée « en dernière minute » pour contraindre les voyageurs à payer, sous la menace de manquer leur vol. Les contrôles approfondis portant sur les motifs de voyage, notamment ceux de jeunes femmes voyageant seules, sont une autre source d’incompréhension. La prévention de la traite des êtres humains et des recrutements illégaux figure parmi les objectifs invoqués pour justifier ces vérifications. Certains voyageurs en contestent toutefois les modalités et déplorent les retards qu’elles occasionnent. « Si on a un visa, c’est que notre motif de voyage est clair », poursuit ce père de famille. Sanctions Ces témoignages font écho à des plaintes déjà exprimées par le passé. Malgré les mesures annoncées il y a quelques années, des usagers continuent de signaler des pratiques similaires. « Oui, ces corruptions persistent à l’aéroport », affirme le sociologue Lanto Ratsida. « Ce n’est pas seulement un problème de comportement individuel, mais un problème structurel », estime-t-il. La multiplicité des intervenants pose la question de l’identification des responsabilités. Plusieurs entités exercent des missions distinctes à Ivato, parmi lesquelles l’Aviation civile de Madagascar (ACM), les douanes, la Police de l’air et des frontières (PAF), la Société de protection et de services de sécurité (SPSS) et l’Agence nationale de lutte contre les fraudes (ANAF). Pour les voyageurs, il n’est pas toujours aisé de savoir de quel service relève un contrôle ni à quelle entité appartient l’agent concerné. Lanto Ratsida avance plusieurs pistes pour renforcer la surveillance. « Il faut multiplier et surveiller nuit et jour les caméras de surveillance dans tous les endroits par où transitent les bagages (zone de tri, soute, etc.), et il ne doit y avoir aucune zone d’ombre », indique-t-il. Il préconise également des sanctions disciplinaires et des poursuites judiciaires lorsque des faits de vol ou de corruption sont établis. Selon lui, une amélioration des salaires et des avantages sociaux pourrait réduire la tentation de rechercher des « revenus complémentaires » illégaux. Il plaide enfin pour un contrôle indépendant, notamment par des audits externes, ainsi que pour une sensibilisation continue à l’éthique et à la déontologie. Reste la question du traitement des plaintes. Lorsqu’un passager dénonce un abus, il ne sait pas toujours à qui s’adresser. La présence de plusieurs intervenants peut compliquer ses démarches et l’identification des responsabilités. Des agents clairement identifiables, un canal de plainte accessible et une information sur les suites données aux signalements contribueraient à rendre les recours plus lisibles et à renforcer la confiance des usagers. Fanilo Mampianintsoa

mg.title: EXPORTATION - Les producteurs de vanille retrouvent espoir
mg.description: Pour 2026-2027, cent quarante et un opérateurs sont agréés pour exporter de la vanille, avec l’objectif de diversifier les marchés et de stimuler la concurrence. La multiplication des exportateurs pourrait favoriser l’ouverture de nouveaux marchés pour la vanille malgache et renforcer les possibilités de vente de cette épice sur le marché international. Pour la campagne 2026-2027, cent quarante et un opérateurs disposent déjà d’un agrément pour exporter de la vanille. Près de cinq cents demandes concernant la vanille et le girofle restent toutefois en cours d’examen auprès du ministère du Commerce et de la Consommation. L’élargissement du nombre d’opérateurs agréés vise notamment à réduire les situations de monopole dans la filière. En encourageant davantage d’entreprises à participer aux activités d’exportation, les autorités espèrent stimuler la concurrence et inciter les opérateurs à rechercher de nouveaux acheteurs. Cette dynamique pourrait également offrir davantage de possibilités aux producteurs pour écouler leur récolte. La recherche de débouchés commerciaux constitue un enjeu important pour la vanille. La présence de plusieurs exportateurs peut encourager la diversification des partenaires commerciaux et limiter la dépendance à un nombre restreint d’acheteurs. Pour les producteurs, l’existence de plusieurs circuits de commercialisation représente une possibilité supplémentaire de vendre leur production. Source de revenus « L’objectif du gouvernement de la Refondation est de sortir de l’ampihimamba (monopole). Nous espérons qu’avec l’augmentation du nombre d’exportateurs, ceux-ci rechercheront eux-mêmes des débouchés commerciaux, avec l’accompagnement du ministère », explique Tiava Rajohnson, directeur général du Commerce extérieur au sein du ministère du Commerce et de la Consommation. Au-delà de l’ouverture commerciale, cette orientation présente un enjeu économique et social. La vanille constitue une source de revenus pour de nombreux producteurs et ménages ruraux. La diversification des acheteurs pourrait contribuer à une meilleure commercialisation de leur récolte. Toutefois, les effets sur les revenus des planteurs dépendront notamment des prix proposés et des conditions d’achat sur le terrain. L’obtention d’un agrément reste soumise à plusieurs vérifications. Les services du ministère examinent les dossiers administratifs et inspectent les entrepôts de stockage afin de contrôler leur conformité. Les opérateurs ayant déjà exporté doivent également respecter leurs obligations antérieures, notamment le rapatriement des devises issues des exportations. Les candidats dont les dossiers présentent des insuffisances peuvent régulariser leur situation. Un délai d’un mois peut notamment leur être accordé pour mettre aux normes un entrepôt jugé non conforme. Cette procédure vise à encadrer l’accès à l’activité d’exportation. Les demandes sont désormais déposées sur la plateforme numérique ALALANA, qui remplace les échanges par courrier électronique. Gratuite, elle permet de suivre le traitement des dossiers. Les organismes habilités, dont l’Inspection générale de l’État et le Bureau indépendant anti-corruption, peuvent consulter les informations relatives à leur instruction. La Direction de l’audit interne et de la lutte contre la corruption du ministère participe également au contrôle. La France, les États-Unis et le Canada figurent parmi les principaux acheteurs de vanille malgache. L’enjeu est désormais de diversifier les débouchés et de faire en sorte que cette ouverture commerciale profite aussi aux producteurs. Lucia Rabarijaona
